ui.intro_text: Create, customize, and download as many QR codes as you need quickly, for free, and without restrictions. Change colors, remove background, and organize your codes easily.

content.feature_custom: Full Customization: Choose code and background colors or remove the background completely.
content.feature_unlimited: Unlimited Generation: Create multiple QR codes simultaneously with no limits or costs.
content.feature_download: Instant Download: Download your QR codes in high resolution ready for print or digital use.
content.feature_privacy: Guaranteed Privacy: Your data and links are processed directly in your browser.
content.usage_step1: Enter the link, text, or desired information in the input field.
content.usage_step2: Customize the title to visually organize your QR codes.
content.usage_step3: Adjust size, choose colors, or check the remove background option.
content.usage_step4: Click the download button to save your QR code image.
content.tip_colors: Use high contrast colors between the code and background to ensure easy scanning.
content.tip_size: Adjust the QR code size based on where it will be printed or displayed.
content.tip_download: You can create and download multiple QR codes at once for different purposes.
content.footer_text: Create and customize your unlimited QR codes right now with Tap to Tool!
